description: Tracks progress investigating whatever `scope` names — see its own description for what each one investigates and which arguments it takes. ALWAYS call this to initiate test results inspection at that level, and ALWAYS follow its `next` field for what to call next. Do not report findings or conclusions to the user before this review's own eyes_review_end call reports completion. In mode "resolve" this additionally acts on what it finds: dynamic content is masked with a match region as each diff is reported, and each step is accepted/rejected/left-unresolved deterministically from its own findings — the response's top-level `resolution` and `regions` tallies, plus each finding's own `regions` detail, report exactly what happened.

batchUrl.description: Eyes batch URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/?accountId=... (a trailing /{sessionId}[/steps/{N}] is fine too and is ignored — pass a session/step URL here as-is, no need to strip it down). Required for scope "batch" and "scenario"; omit it otherwise.

mode.description: What this investigation is for. "resolve" (the default — used whenever mode is left unspecified, including for a plain "review"/"check"/"look at" request with no further qualification) additionally acts on what it finds: each diff's dynamic content is masked with a match region as it is reported, and each step is deterministically accepted/rejected/left-unresolved from its own findings. These are pending, undoable decisions, not a commit — eyes_resolve_save (a separate, later call requiring its own explicit user approval) is what actually writes them to the baseline, and eyes_resolve_reset can discard them before that. So do not switch to "inspect" out of general caution about mutating actions or to avoid asking for confirmation — that caution belongs at the eyes_resolve_save step, not here. "inspect" only reads and reports, with no mutation at all — use it only when the user explicitly asks to just describe/summarize the differences, or explicitly asks not to resolve steps or add regions (e.g. "just tell me what changed", "don't resolve anything yet"); a bare "review"/"check this batch" does not qualify and should use the resolve default. Only specify it at the top of a traversal, or when a prior call's `next` output already indicated one — and then pass that value through as given, never omitted or modified.

restart.description: Defaults to false — omit this to reuse whatever is already cached for this node. Pass true only to explicitly discard every cached finding/completion for this node and everything beneath it and review it from scratch — e.g. to independently re-review something already reviewed, as part of this investigation or a separate one, since otherwise its cached results are reused as-is.

rootScope.description: Determines the shape of this call's `next` output. Only specify it when a prior call's `next` output already indicated one — and then pass that value through as given, never omitted or modified.

scenarioName.description: The scenario (test) name. Required for scope "scenario"; omit it otherwise.

scope.description: Which entity this call is about, and therefore which arguments it takes: "batch" takes batchUrl; "scenario" takes batchUrl and scenarioName; "session" takes sessionUrl; "step" takes sessionUrl and stepIndex. Not to be confused with `rootScope`, a separate argument: `scope` is the entity this call is about, `rootScope` bounds how far `next` ever escalates beyond it. What each one investigates: "batch" — every unresolved session in a batch, grouped into scenarios; ALWAYS call this first for a batch-wide test results inspection. "scenario" — every unresolved session sharing one scenario (test) name within a batch. "session" — every non-matching (isMatching:false) step of one session; a step with no checkpoint image (an aborted run's trailing steps) or no baseline image (a newly added checkpoint) is decided here, not investigated — it never appears among the steps to inspect. "step" — every changed area (from eyes_inspect_changed_areas) of one step.

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present). Required for scope "session" and "step"; omit it otherwise.

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps. Required for scope "step"; omit it otherwise.

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_review_progress
